snippet.title: How to Make Wise Decisions: Relationships, Big Purchases, and Life Choices
snippet.description:
In this conversation from the Jubilee Church Podcast, Lead Pastor Bryan Mowrey offers practical and biblical guidance for making wise decisions in every area of life—from relationships to buying a home.

Bryan unpacks the role of prayer, community counsel, and biblical principles in decision-making, showing how wisdom leads to long-term peace and flourishing.

📺 Watch the full conversation here: https://youtu.be/1LiRKQHHUmU

Tags: christian decision making, biblical wisdom, how to make wise choices, christian relationships, buying a house tips, godly decision making, christian life advice, jubilee church, christian podcast
